svg.title: GATE DMGFPS
svg.text: GATE DMGFPS - a low frame rate never fakes a yield or a crash
The plastic work of the 60 fps run (one step a read) against sim time; a dot where each batched run ended - the page's first read at or after
the 60 fps end (dashed). Every dot sits on the line: bitwise the 60 fps run at that step. The damage layer on.
the Cub dropped at FAR 23.473's limit sink
the Cub into a trunk at 30 m/s, the centreline
CRASHED: the airframe crushed (6.7 kJ of plastic work) - 14 schedules, 14 bitwise
the metal Cessna into a trunk at 30 m/s, the centreline
CRASHED: the airframe crushed (4.8 kJ of plastic work) - 14 schedules, 14 bitwise
the Cub into a trunk at 30 m/s, the wing 2.5 m out
CRASHED: a wing member broke - 14 schedules, 14 bitwise
the metal Cessna dropped at FAR 23.473's limit sink
the Cessna on floats' 5 m/s level pancake on the water
the Cessna on floats dropped onto the water at FAR 23.473's limit sink
the twin's float nose-in (90 km/h, 5 m/s, 20 deg)
